A '''gas regulator''' was a piece of [[Life support/Legends|lift support]] equipment used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It helped to regulate the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] inside a [[pressure tent]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
